title: fly_connectome_data_tutorial: Hands-on tutorial for fly connectome data analysis
description: Tutorial materials for working with Drosophila connectome datasets at the San Juan Winter School on Connectomics and Brain Simulation (SJCABS, sjcabs.com). Hands-on R + Python walkthrough covering BANC, FAFB, MANC, hemibrain, and maleCNS: loading, analysing, and visualising neuronal morphologies, synaptic connectivity, and network structure.
